# Hybrid Pro

> Hybrid Pro is personal coaching from Akash, a certified personal trainer with Active IQ Level 3 and REPs UAE credentials. Online coaching is available now. Hybrid Pro Fitness Studio is opening in Bengaluru and does not have a published street address yet.

## Coaching

- [Home](https://hybridpro.in/): Personal coaching for strength, fat loss, and habits.
- [Programs](https://hybridpro.in/programs): Strength, fat loss, and muscle blocks of 8 to 12 weeks.
- [Coaching](https://hybridpro.in/coaching): Assessment, a plan in the app, video form reviews, and weekly check-ins.
- [Pricing](https://hybridpro.in/pricing): Foundation ₹3,999 per month, Performance ₹11,999 per month, Elite ₹24,999 per month, Hyrox ₹3,500 for 90 days.
- [Studio](https://hybridpro.in/studio): Hybrid Pro Fitness Studio, opening in Bengaluru. Online coaching is available now.

## App and shop

- [Member app](https://hybridpro.in/app): Workouts, progress, and coach chat. Meals are included on Performance and Elite only.
- [App page](https://hybridpro.in/app): How to open the Hybrid Pro app.
- [Shop](https://hybridpro.in/shop): Digital guides. Coaching plans are separate from the shop.

## Notes

- [Why hybrid training](https://hybridpro.in/blog/why-hybrid-athletes-out-progress-pure-lifters): Strength work first, then conditioning.
- [Eating for a training block](https://hybridpro.in/blog/eating-for-a-heavy-training-block): Nutrition is included on Performance and Elite.
- [Recovery](https://hybridpro.in/blog/recovery-habits-that-move-the-needle): Sleep, protein, and a repeatable week of load.
- [About Akash](https://hybridpro.in/about): Founder and coach.
- [Contact](https://hybridpro.in/#contact): hello@hybridpro.fit
